story.title: GalaxEye Launches World's First OptoSAR Satellite — India's Largest Private Space Payload Reaches Orbit
story.summary: Indian deep-tech startup GalaxEye successfully launched Mission Drishti aboard a SpaceX rocket, making it the world's first satellite to combine electro-optical and synthetic aperture radar (OptoSAR) sensors in a single 190-kilogram platform — the largest satellite ever built by an Indian private company. The satellite is designed to capture high-quality Earth observation data regardless of weather or lighting conditions, overcoming limitations of conventional single-sensor systems. Prime Minister Narendra Modi publicly hailed the launch as a landmark achievement for India's private space sector. GalaxEye expects to begin commercial data sales within eight weeks, with defence and security agencies anticipated as anchor customers.
